tei:div.tei:p: rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas bsang zhing sbyangs pa'i ngang las sa bon so so las rigs lnga yab yum du bskyed pa la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas 'bar ba'i lta bas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa bstim zhing dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab la/ gtor ma'i bar gyis mchod nas snyoms par zhugs te bde ba chen po'i mes 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du bskyed nas mtheb srin gyis mnye zhing*/ om̐ āḥ hūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod do/ /de nas rang nyid he ru ka dang*/ las kyi slob ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal dang*/ ldan pas nub dang shar du langs la gnyis kas dza zhes brjod cing slob dpon gyis thig sna gtad pa slob mas blangs nas chos thams cad ro gcig par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā a t+yan+ta a nu ga ta

| sarba dharmā a t+yan+ta a nu pra be sha ya sarba dharmā hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bsgril ba rdo rje'i lte ba la dkris la bdud rtsi gtor nas slar yang brkyang ba slob mas bzung ste lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas 'og dang 'og nas steng du nam mkha' la thig dang po gdab bo/ /de nas g.yas skor gyis lho nas byang dang me nas dbang ldan dang*/ rlung nas bden bral dang*/ de nyid nas dbang ldan dang*/ me nas srin po dang*/ me nas rlung dang*/ bden bral nas dbang ldan du gnas pas snga ma bzhin gdab cing*/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas/ khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar/ /thig skud sgra yis bskul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing btab pas thig gi rjes de dag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par grub par dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma ho'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg nas | slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dbus su song la hi/ zhes brjod cing phyogs bzhir bltas pas sgo bzhi dbye bar bsams nas/ dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nang nas rim pa bzhin dkar po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ sngon po rnams g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis g.yas skor du bri zhing*/ chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /sgyu 'phrul zhes bya'i rgyal po che'i/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tsi tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing 'dres pa dang*/ sbom phra dang yo ba dang chad pa la sogs pa'i skyon med par bri bar bya'o/ /de nas hūm̐ gi sngags kyis dbus kyi phur pa dbyung zhing*/ rtsig pa'i rim pa ltar tshon rtsi rnams bkye nas lhag ma slob ma rnams kyis 'drir gzhug go /de'ang dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa ni kye'i rdo rje la sogs pa dang 'dra la/ lha snam ni shar sngo/

lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'o/ /dbus pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ shar nas rim pas rdo rje/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri dang*/ mtshams bzhir ka pā la bzhis mdzes par bya'o/ /de'i khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma rnams dang*/ rgyan dang lhab lhub thams cad kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi las so/ /de nas phyem red kyi tshe bzlas pa'i bar sta gon bzhin byas nas mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs te dkyil 'khor bsang zhing sbyangs pa'i ngang las srung 'khor dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i rten gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs ltar bskyed nas | brten pa lha rnams ni slob dpon he ru ka yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis gsang gnas nas 'byin pa'i tshul gyis spros la skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la gnas pa la mchod cing bstod de bstim la bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang yang gnyis su med par byas te slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ji lta ba'i ye shes pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma lus pas bskor ba'ang spyan drangs la mchod pa dang bstod pas mnyes par byas nas ro gcig par byas te/ dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs nas mchod cing bstod de gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab la dbang gi lha de dag dang yang gnyis su med par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las rdo rje slob dpon gtso bo 'ba' zhig gi rnam pas bye bas shar phyogs su gnas nas lha so so'i mtshan sngon du 'gro ba'i yi ge brgya pa brjod pas byin gyis brlab cing brtan par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o/ /de nas chu gnyis sngon du 'grau ba'i mchod pa lnga gos zung dang bcas pa dang*/

nang gi mchod pa dang | bstod pa rnams kyis mchod nas gtor ma dang po 'di nyid kyi cho gas dpal he ru ka dang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa zhing skyong rnams la 'bul lo/ /grub na zhi ba'am rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gis kyang mchod par bya'o | | mchod pa'o/ /de nas slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blangs te nang du 'jug pa'i tshe sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+rod gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas sgo phye la 'jug go /dbang blangs pa'i mthar slob ma thogs pa med par 'jug pa'i phyir/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni | | gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces bden pa'i stobs lan gsum brjod do/ /bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'o/ /de nas bdag nyid mchod pa sta gon bzhin byas nas/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgribs la khrus byas pa'i slob ma phyag 'tshal nas 'khod pa rnams gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ / slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo mkha' 'gro mar bcas pa'i// lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas/ bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas | | he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni | | bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags brjod cing las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bsangs nas bdud rtsi lce la gtor zhing*/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod nas byin gyis brlabs la/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gi sngags kyis gdong g.yogs bcings me tog gi phreng ba'ang gtad do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis bu khyod su yin zhes dri/ slob mas skal bzang bdag ces lan gdab | yang ci la dga'/ bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya dang*/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go zhes dris pa dang*/ lan gyis rigs nges par rtogs par byas nas/ slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis kas slob ma'i snying gi nang du kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas nang gi mun pa sel bar bsams nas snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho/ sing+nghi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod nas byang chub kyi sems bskyed la spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsang bar gdams nas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sgo ma bzhi'i phyag mtshan thogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhi 'phros pas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor bcug par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod la yol ba'i nang du gzhug pa'am yol ba dbye bar bya'o/ / de nas na ma ste hūm̐/ na mo mi hūm̐/ na mo nā ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing sku gsung thugs kyi phyag gsum 'tshal nas shar phyogs su 'gro ba'am/ phyin par mos la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal gyis byin gyi brlab tu gsol ba'i yid kyis snying gar thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye pū dza u pas+tha nā ya ād+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+ya/

a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes brjod nas phyag 'tshal du gzhug go /de nas lho phyogs nas rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal gyi dbang bskur bar gsol ba'i yid kyis dpral bar thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī ye pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na sam+bha ba a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes brjod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas nub phyogs nas pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba'i yid kyis mgrin par thal mo sbyar nas/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī ye pū dza pra warta na ya ād+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a mi tā bha ba dharma tsakra pra warta nā ya māṃ/ zhes brjod cing phyag 'tshal/ de nas byang gi phyogs nas sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal gyis phrin las bsgrub par gsol ba'i yid kyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye pū dza karma ne ya ād+ma naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha sing+nghi karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes brjod nas phyag 'tshal du bcug la slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'khod cing maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ / bdag la sdom pa rnams kyang stsol/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa// slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab nas | sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song | | 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o | | rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar gyis/ / byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes brjod do/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pa/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar gyis/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par brjod/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/

/sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung*/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa'i mchog /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ khyod kyis yang dag gzung bar gyis/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus byos/ /zhes brjod pas sdom pa bsgrags la/ de rnams rjes su gzung ba'i bsam pas sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ rigs thams cad kyi sdom pa gzung ba lan gsum rjes su brjod pas sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug go /de ltar thob pa'i dam tshig mi nyams par bsrung bar gdams pa'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la | ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya'i/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dang*/ yang snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes brjod nas spyi bor bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes nyes dmigs dang*/ de nas khyor chu sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ / dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ / rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gnyis ka dang*/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas bsgo ba de khyod kyis gyis shig khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa byas na mi bde ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re zhes bla ma'i bka' mnyan par bsgo ba ste/

rnam pa bzhis dam la bzhag go /de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis rlob mdzod la/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med pa/ /da lta nyid du dbab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs pa'i slob ma la/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes pas zhen pa dang bral ba'i yid bskyed nas | gnyis kas slob ma he ru ka'i rnam pas langs te gnas pa'i 'og gi gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan par bsgoms nas snying gi nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i he ru ka yab yum dmigs te/ gzhi'i rlung gis rkang mthil gyi rlung bskyod cing*/ des sum mdo'i me sbar bas lus thams cad gang bas sdig pa dang rtog pa thams cad bsregs/ lto ba'i chu bskol/ snying ga'i sa bsregs/ 'od kyi snang bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs pa char chen po bab pa ltar lus la thim pas ro gcig tu gyur pas/ snying ga'i he ru ka gar mdzad par bsam zhing*/ zla mtshan dang ldan pa'i mdom dkris dang*/ byi la'i brun dang sbags pa'i gu gul gyi dud pas bdug rol mo'i sgra drag tu dkrol/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya a a/ zhes bya ba dang | lha lnga'i sngags brjod pas lus dang ngag dang yid la babs pa'i rtags 'byung zhing*/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod nas rdo rje spyi bor rgya gram du bzhag pas de mi nyams shing brtan par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma la dkyil 'khor bstan cing gzhug pa'i phyir 'di skad ces/ 'di yi bsod nams gang yin pas/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /'di yi dngos grub gang yin dang*/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur/ /'di yi bsod nams ji lta bar | | dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod nas nam mkha'i kha dog gis dngos grub kyi ltas brtags te/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes brjod cing me tog phreng ba dkyil 'khor la dor nas lha'i rigs brtags la/

lha dang bla ma bskul ba'i phyir/ oṃ pra ti gri h+na s+t+wa mi maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes brjod de spyi bor bzhag la/ mig 'bras gnyis/ oṃ du bskyed la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med | | oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hrī praṃ/ zhes brjod nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang du lhung gyur pa/ /de ni khyod kyi lhag pa'i lha | | dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu skyed/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba'i phun tshogs thams cad dang*/ /dngos grub kun khyod 'grub par 'gyur | | dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes brjod la gtso bo nas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i mthar thug pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bstan par bya'o/ /nang gi 'jug pa ste 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas

| | he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can | | ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso/ /de bzhin bdag la'ang de stsol cig /ces lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan du mos pa'i steng du me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i rnam pas gnas pa gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang rnga yab la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung gis bskor ba la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mos mchod pas mchod/ byang chub sems dpas shis pa brjod/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu len/ de bzhin gshegs pas khrus gsol bar bsams nas/ dngos su gu gul gyis bdugs la yungs dkar gyis brab cing drag po'i sngags dang shis pa dang mchod pa bya'o | | sngon du bya ba'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas slob ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i snying ga'i hūm̐ gi tha mar bkod par gnyis kas bsgom zhing snying po'i sngags lan gsum rjes su bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod du bcug nas/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag la/ 'di la zhes 'don pa bsgyur nas/ oṃ dharma kuṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i phyir slob ma dang dbang rdzas swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la so so'i sa bon las byung ba'i phyag mtshon sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas so so'i rigs dang 'brel ba'i sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus pas rigs so so'i kha dog dang phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas par gyur pa'i skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas te/

dbang rdzas la dbang bskur nas rigs bdag gi rgyas btab pa de snyoms par zhugs pa zhu ba las/ dbang rdzas so sor gyur pa sngags dang tshigs su bcad pas sbyin zhing de brtan par bya ba'i phyir bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ro/ /de dag gi tshe dbang gi lha rnams kyis gong du brjod pa'i las mdzad par gnyis kas bsam zhing*/ rang rang gi rigs bdag gi rgyas btab nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la soso'i brda sprad do/ / de'ang hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang gsum gyi | | gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin/ /oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing chu'i dbang sbyin no/ /trām̐ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /bde gshegs kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang*/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa pa ṭa a pa laṃ ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbu rgyan gyi dbang sbyin no/ /hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje'i 'di ni khyod kyis zungs | | oṃ ma hā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje'i dbang sbyin no// a las don yod grub pa ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa las kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab ¡Ã dbyangs kyi ( ¡¶ lu ¡· mchog gi

) rjes 'gror bshad | khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed | | oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes brjod cing dril bu'i dbang sbyin no/ /oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + sku mdog ) dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ shrī he ru ka badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi ming gdags te/ skyes pa dang bud med kyi dbye bas mi bskyod rdo rje/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje mā ma kī rdo rje snyems ma la sogs pa mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi ming ngo*/ /rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje/ rtag pa'i rdo rje | oṃ mdzad rdo rje/ rdo rje spyan ma la sogs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi'o// rin chen rdo rje/ nam mkha'i rdo rje/ gzi brjid rdo rje/ rdo rje phreng ba ma la sogs pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi'o/ /'od dpag med rdo rje/ pad+ma'i rdo rje/ chos kyi rdo rje/ rdo rje gos dkar mo la sogs pa 'od dpag med kyi'o/ / don yod rdo rje/ las kyi rdo rje/ dam tshig rdo rje/ rdo rje sgrol ma la sogs pa don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi ming ngo*/ /de ltar rig pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dbang bskur bas phung po lnga dang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga sbyangs nas rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i go 'phang thob par byas zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/

/rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ e ṣa dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ rdo rje byin pa snying gar bzung nas/ snying gi nang du yang rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis kas mos pa ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs te slob ma'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dpa' bo chen pos mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ / 'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa/ /de ni deng 'dir mdzad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas slob ma dbang stegs kyi steng du gnas pa hūm̐ las rdo rje 'chang chen po sngon po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur ba'i bar snga ma ltar bsgom zhing*/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nas/ /sngags kyi bar brjod pas rdo rje byin la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes de kho na nyid brjod nas | 'di ni rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa dang*/ aḥzhes brjod nas dril bu gtad la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ / rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam par rgyal bas bzhed*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes de kho na nyid brjod/ de nas yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku la yid gtad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /dam tshig phyag rgya zhes su bshad/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/

/de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes dam tshig gsum byin nas bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur la/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan nas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod de/ me tog gtor la dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa thams cad kyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par byas par gnyis kas bsam mo/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas rten gyi dkyil 'khor byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa lam gyi chos mtshon par byed pa yin la lha rnams ni phung po dang*/ 'byung ba dang | nyon mongs pa la sogs pa 'khor ba'i chos rnam par dag pa ye shes dang yon tan dang phrin las la sogs pa 'bras bu'i chos mtshon par byed cing de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dang thugs la gnyis su med par tshang ngo*/ /zhes dkyil 'khor dang*/ lha dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid brjod do/ /de nas rdul tshon gyis bsgos pa'i gser gyi thur ma la sogs pas mig dbye ba'i tshul du bya zhing*/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis | | 'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ / rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hrī praṃ/ zhes mi shes pa'i rab rib bsal nas chos kyi mig dri ma med par thob par gyis/ zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas me long dag par shar ba'i gzugs brnyan bltar bcug nas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la | | sems can don kun mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye | | zhes brjod nas yul gzugs brnyan dang byed pa sgyu ma'i tshul du shes par gyis shig ces bsgo'o/

/de nas mda' gzhu gtad pa phyogs drug tu 'phen pa'i tshul byed du gzhug cing*/ ho de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang lhan cig rjes su chags par byos shig ces brjod nas/ bdag la chags pa dang gzhan la 'tshe ba/ theg pa chen po la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i sems gzhom bar gyis shig ces bsgo ba rnams sems can gyi don gyi rjes su gnang ba'o/ /de nas lag tu 'khor lo by-in la/ deng nas bzung ste 'jig rten la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa/ /kun tu dri med sdig med pa// skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo skor/ /zhes chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bsgos nas/ dung 'bud du bcug la/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ / yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /zhes chos kyi dung 'bud par bsgo ba ni/ chos 'chad pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o/ /de nas sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu byin la/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar byed dang gnod sogs dang*/ /bskrad dang gsad pa de bzhin te/ /las de dag ni bsgrub par gyis/ /zhes gzhan don du las de dag bsgrub par bsgo ba ni phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas snam sbyar gyon nas/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod bton/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sing+nghi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur+bhu wa swaḥ gang la ngas lung bstan pa bzhin sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang | dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad do/ /zhes brjod nas rtogs pa bskyed de lung bstan pa'o// de nas slob dpon brnyas par mi bya zhing*/

/gus pa yis ni mchod par bya// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yongs su gtang bar mi bya'o/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsrung bya ste/ /rnam par rtog med gos med par/ /rang lha'i rnal 'byor gnas pa yis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bsten par bya/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /dngos grub thams cad grub par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod pa ni dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /de nas/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir | | btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /de ring sdig las rnam grol te// de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyis ni 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal rnams las grol/ zhes brjod pa ni gzengs bstod pa'o/ /de ltar rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed pa'i rim pa dbyibs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes brda sprad do/ /bum pa'i dbang ngo*// //de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur rab gsang ba/ /gtso bo chen pos bdag la stsol/ /zhes gsol ba lan gsum 'debs su bcug nas/ gdong g.yogs bcing la yig 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi gtor nas slob dpon dpal he ru ka dngos sam ye shes kyi rig ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mar dmigs la/ gnyis ka'i gnas lnga dang*/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ yum gyis/ kye ho gnyen mchog la sogs pa'i glus bskul ba dang*/ bde ba myong zhing slob ma la dbang sbyin pa'i 'dun pas snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul zhal du zhugs snying gar 'od du zhu/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bur gnas pa'i bde ba chen pos phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod nas phaṭa ces brjod pas phyung la/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/

/sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ / gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas slob ma'i khar sbyin zhing*/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang gi lha thams cad kyis bkra shis dang*/ mchod pa mdzad par bsam mo/ /slob mas kyang mid nas lus thams cad gang bas ngag gi dri ma sbyangs nas 'od dpag tu med par bsgoms la/ a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod du gzhug go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba bdud rtsi'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag zab pa sngags kyi lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes brda sprad do/ /gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// //de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ slob dpon go 'phang che rang bzhin/ /skal ba chen po bdag la stsol / / bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang bskur ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa/ /brtul zhugs mchog ni khyod drin gyi/ /bdag la nges par stsal lags kyi/ /des ni sems can dpag med don/ /ji ltar 'dul bzhin bdag bgyid do/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas snga ma ltar gdong g.yogs bcing zhing bdud rtsi gtor la/ gnyis kas slob ma he ru kar bskyed nas dngos sam ye shes kyi rig ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mar bskyed nas/ mdzes ma 'di ni gzung ba dang*/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags/ /gzungs ma 'di ni yid dga' ma/ khyod kyis rtag tu bstan par bya/ /zhes brjod nas slob ma la gtad do/ /de nas rig mas/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad+mar tsum+ban/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ / zhes dris pa'i lan du/ slob mas/ ji skad

gsungs pa'i dam tshig la/ /bdag ni ci dgar spro gyur to/ /zhes lan btab pas lha mo de dgyes nas/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba pad+mar ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ /'di nyid du ni rtag par bzhugs | | blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces gsung zhing slob ma'i pang du byon nas/ slar yang lha'i sku yab yum du gsal bar dmigs pa'i gnas lnga dang mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas | slob mas kun nas dkris pa dang bral zhing lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya ba'i 'dun pas snyoms par zhugs pas sna tshogs pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ rnam nyed dang*/ mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i skad cig ma la dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rnams skyes pa ngo sprad cing slob mas kyang bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de'i tshe nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i char mngon par phab cing bkra shis kyi dbyangs brjod par bsam mo/ /de nas/ thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /gnyis su med pa'i chos kun ni/ /gnyis kyi dngos pos mtshon gyur pa/ /de phyir rig ma 'di ni mchog /de bas khyed kyis rtag tu ni/ /'khor ba bral bar mi bya'o | | 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed na/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces pa dang | ji ltar dbang bskur tshul la ni/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun thob pa// de ltar byang chub spyod sogs dang*/ /dge ba'i tshul ¡Ã gzhan dag ( ¡¶ lu ¡· sogs dbang ) gis min/ /bdag po'i dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /rtag tu sdom pa bskyang bar bya/ /bza' ba sha lnga bdud rtsi ste/ /bsrung ba 'di las dam tshig gzhan//

dkon mchog 'jig gsod bud med kun/ /gzhan las len dang ngag gi brdzun | | rnal 'byor rgyud du gang bshad pa/ /de yang cho ga bzhin du bsrung*// zhes che ba brjod pa dang dam tshig bstan nas/ gdong g.yogs phye la byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag zung 'jug chos kyi lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes brda sprad do/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// // de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas/ snga ma ltar gdong g.yogs bcing zhing bdud rtsi gtor la/ bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas su bcug nas gsum pa'i ye shes kyis mtshon pa'i de kho na nyid tshig gis ngo sprad pa'i phyir/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes don bshad la yid mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye la don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag mthar thug chos kyi lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes brda sprad do/ /dbang bzhi pa'o || || de nas slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis dam tshig dang sdom pa bsdus te khas blangs nas/ lus dang longs spyod thams cad phul bar mos pas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyod kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*/ /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ gtang rag phul nas/

dngos su ci 'byor pa'i yon gyis kyang bla ma mnyes par bya'o/ /bla mas kyang*/ gnas skabs 'di'am gzhan du/ dam tshig dang sdom pa dang lam gyi rim pa bstan par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod cing bstod nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub blangs la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces bzod par gsol nas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis cho ga pas lhag chad bskangs nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig/ sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ / des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces lan gsum du smon lam btab nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol | | sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod nas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus nas/ a kā ro'i mthar/ oṃ gi li gi li hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes brjod cing g.yon pa'i srin lag gis dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bshig nas rdul tshon ma lus pa bsdus pa rin po che'i bum par blugs la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor nas las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ gnas gsum bsrungs te dga' ston la longs spyad nas ci bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /mjug gi cho ga'o// //de ltar bla ma las thob pa'i/ /dbang don rang gis goms byas pas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /dbang bskur nas ni de 'tshang rgya/ / tshul 'di'ang ye shes 'byung gnas dpal/ /de bzhin nyi ma 'bum dang yang*// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la sogs pas/ /bskul nas sngags 'chang 'phags pas sbyar/ /de ltar sgyu ma rol pa yi/ /dbang bskur rol pa bshad pa yis/ / 'gro kun tshul 'dis rnam rol nas/

/bde ba che la rol par shog /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ku ku ri pa'i man ngag la brten pa'i gzhung rim pa gsal ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba 'di ni dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas shing mo glang gi lo ston zla 'bring po la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba yongs su rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /dpal sgyu ma bde ba chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /srid pa'i sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba/ /sgyu ma chen mor phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgyu ma rnam par rol pa bshad/ /myong snang bzhin du ma grub phyir/ /'di kun sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul te/ /de nyid las ni byung ba'i phyir/ / grol ba'ang ci phyir sgyu ma min ( ¡¶ zha ¡· yin ) / /de phyir bud med sgyu ma yi/ /rnam par rol pas rol pa yis/ /bde chen rol pas rol 'gyur ba'i/ /thabs 'di bla na med pa yin/ /dbang dang dam tshig thob pa yis/ /dngos grub don du rnal 'byor bsgom/ /mnyam par bzhag dang yan lag gi /rnal 'byor gnyis kyis bsdus pa yin/ /de la mnyam par bzhag pa la gnyis las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ rang he ru kar skad cig gis dmigs pa'i snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi yi ge sngon po las 'od byung bas rang dang gzhan gyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor bla mas dbur brgyan pa spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdang*/ na maḥshrī he ru ka ma hā mā yā maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥs bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal nas/ snying ga nas sprul pa'i me tog la sogs pa phyi dang*/

nang bdud rtsis mchod la/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ /ma lus sangs rgyas spyan sngar ni/ /bdag gis so sor bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*/ /sgyu 'phrul gtso bo yab yum dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa dang*/ /chos mchog la yang skyabs su mchi/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ /byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ / bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas myur du 'grub 'gyur te/ / sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su sgrol bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba mtha' dag dang phrad par 'dod pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang*/ chags sdang med ¡Ã cing ( ¡¶ zha ¡· pa'i sems ) mnyam pa nyid kyi btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi bsgom mo/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas he ru ka āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ he ni chos thams cad rgyu dang bral zhing 'phel ba dang 'grib pa med la/ yongs su rtog pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba'o/ /ru ni chos thams cad sgra brnyan dang 'dra zhing dga' ba dang ldan la skye 'gag dang bral ba'o/ /ka ni chos thams cad gnas pa dang bral zhing bde ba dang ldan la ma skyes pa'i de kho na nyid de/ yi ge gsum gyi don dang ldan pa nyid do/ /zhes dran par byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang las sngon gyi smon lam gyi rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang

| raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar sngo | lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyogs kun du 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ ra ba dang*/ dra ba dang*/ gur dang*/ bla re dang*/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas yongs su bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom mo/ /de'i nang du e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo rnams 'dres pa las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi/ phyi rol nas rim pa bzhin/ sngon po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing mda' yab dang pu shus yongs su bskor ba/ gzhi'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris nas mdzes par phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ sgo'i steng du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa chos kyi 'khor lo dang gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me long dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ rnga yab la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas spras shing kun du sgrib pa med pa'i phyi rol gyi khor yug tu shar nas rim pa bzhin du/ drag tu gtum pa/ 'jigs par byed pa/ 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ tshang tshing 'khrigs pa dang*/ me nas rim pa bzhin/ dbang phyug nags tshal/ mun pa mi bzad pa/ ki li ki la'i sgra sgrogs pa/ ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod brgyad du de nyid kyi rim pas brgya byin/ gshin rje/ chu lha | gnod sbyin/ me lha/

srin po/ rlung lha/ dbang ldan te phyogs skyong ba brgyad | shing chen po brgyad la gnas pa'i zhing skyong ¡Ã chen po ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· ba ) brgyad/ mchod rten chen po brgyad/ chu chen po brgyad/ me chen po brgyad/ sprin chen po brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro dang*/ ro langs la sogs pas gang bar bsam/ gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus su rdo rje'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ro dang bcas pa'i nyi ma'i gdan dang*/ phyogs bzhir nyi ma 'ba' zhig gi gdan dang*/ mtshams bzhir bum pa la gnas pa'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi dang*/ lha snam gyi khor yug tu bcud sna tshogs kyis gang zhing 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa brgyad gnas par bsgom mo/ /de nas brten pa lha bskyed pa'i phyir gdan dbus ma'i steng du rang gi sems he ru ka yab yum du skad cig gis lhag par mos nas snyoms par zhugs pas rjes su chags pas nye bar bskul bas ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ba'i ) khams gnyis bha gar son pa spros pas gdan bzhi'i steng du thig le'i gzugs bzhir blta'o/ /mthar rjes su chags pa'i mes yab yum gnyis kyang 'od du zhu nas bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig le gcig tu gyur par bsgom mo/ /de nas skad cig gis phyogs bzhi'i thig le rnams rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhir gyur nas/ kye ho gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyis pad+ma sad mdzad pa/ /a la la ho/ bde ba chen ¡Ã po'i ( ¡¶ lu ¡· po rab tu ) dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /nyi ma'i 'od kyis pad+mo kha 'byed ltar/ /a la la ho/ bde ba chen po'i gar gyis rab tu dgyes par mdzod/ /ces mgrin gcig tu glus bskul nas/ lha mo rnams skar mda'i tshul gyis dbus kyi thig le la 'dres shing gcig tu gyur pa'i thig le dum bu gsum du gyur te/

'og gi thig le ā li las zla ba dang*/ steng gi kā li las nyi ma dang*/ bar gyi hūm̐ las rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las byung ba'i dpal he ru ka ni sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo ba/ g.yas ser ba/ rgyab dmar ba/ g.yon ljang ba/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'phyar ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin cing de nyid kyis mi'i g.yang gzhi gos su gyon pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan zhing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa | gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i pang na gnas pa'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'ang kha dog dang phyag mtshan dang nyams yab dang mtshungs pa nyid de/ 'on kyang phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can no/ /gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ brla gnyis la hā ljang gu bkod nas/ yum gyi bha ga pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa dang

| yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje sngon po rtse mo lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par byin gyis brlabs nas/ lha rnams dbyung ba'i phyir snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul nas nye bar spyan drangs pa zhal du zhugs/ snying gar ¡Ã rab tu ( ¡¶ lu ¡· 'od du ) bzhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa thig le bzhir gyur pa las byung ba'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi rim pa bzhin nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros/ rang rang dang rjes su 'brel ba'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus nas gcig tu gyur pa las phyogs bzhir 'khod par bsams te/ de'ang shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo zhal g.yas ser/ rgyab dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga g.yon pa gnyis na dril bu dang*/ ka pā la 'dzin pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ zhal g.yas sngo/ rgyab dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gnyis na ba dan rtse gsum pa dang | ce spyang 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal g.yas ser | rgyab sngo/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na pad+ma dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na ka pā la dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ g.yas ser/ rgyab dmar/ g.yon sngo ba/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang*/ ḍa ma ru dang g.yon pa gnyis na ka pā la dang*/ zhags pa 'dzin pa ste/ thams cad kyang zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyan dang cha lugs can no/ /de nas snga ma ltar de dag thams cad kyi gnas lnga byin gyis brlab bo/ /mig tu om̐ dkar po/ mgrin par am̐ḥ dmar po/ rna bar a ser po/ snar ṣe dkar po/ dpral bar tsi ser po/ snying gar hūm̐ dmar po dmigs pa rnams/ skye mched rnam par dag pa rdo rje ma drug tu bltas la/

rang gi snying gi nang gi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sgyu ma chen po'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pas mnyes par byas te/ rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i rtsa ba'i phyag gis lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin pa rnams snying ga nas rim gyis spros pas ye shes pa rnams dgug pa dang | gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du byas pas rang dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ oṃ e h+ye hi shrī he ru ka ma hā mā yā maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba ḍā ki nī/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pā sha hrī/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ā be sha aḥ zhes brjod do/ /phyi ma ni e h+ye hi mi sbyor ro/ /de nas yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyi snang bas mkha' 'gro ma lnga dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i rigs lnga rang rang gi rigs dang rjes su 'brel pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dbang gi lha spyan drangs la/ snga ma bzhin mchod cing bstod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin/ /badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing*/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bo bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ rig mas glu dang*/ sems dpas bkra shis dang*/ khro bos bar chad sel ba dang*/ lha mos mchod pa'i las mdzad de/ chu'i rgyun des lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma bzhi dag dbang bzhi thob/ lam bzhi bsgom zhing*/ sku bzhi thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas/

chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ dbang rtags su he ru ka la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma lnga la rim pa bzhin rtag pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas mdun du mngon par 'du byas pa'i bdud rtsi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa myangs pas lha thams cad bdud rtsis yongs su gang zhing bde ba dang ting nge 'dzin gyi ro dam pa myang bar bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas lha mo rnams dang ¡Ã 'khor 'das ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dkyil 'khor pa ) thams cad kyi bdag nyid he ru ka la mgrin gcig tu bstod par bsam zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ / sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ste badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes kyang brjod do/ /de nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de/ ji srid gnas kyi bar du yid mnyam par bzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa dbyibs kyi bdag nyid do// //de nas dmigs pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing thabs shes rab zung du 'jug par bya ba'i phyir/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od kyis snod bcud dang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams rang la bsdus shing yum yang bsdus nas/ yab 'ba' zhig tu gnas pa'i snying pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i rnam par gnas pa'i dbus su thig le'i ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sen mo bzlum pa tsam dang*/ de'i ¡Ã steng du ( ¡¶ lu ¡· 'og tu ) rak+ta'i ngo bo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor tshad de tsam gnyis kyi bar du rlung dang khams dang sems 'dres pa'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam zhig bsams nas de la sems cung zhig gtad do/ /de nas thig le las sgra sing pa zhig byung bas rkyen byas nas steng gi zla ba la bu ga shin tu phra ba zhig dod de

| thig le las 'od kyi srad bu rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad ltar phra ba zhig la nyi zer ltar phra ba'i ā li kā li phreng ba'i tshul du brgyus pa gcig dbugs phyir rgyu ba dang mtshungs par 'thon/ nyi zla kha sbyor la lan phyed dang bdun du dkris/ yid kyis oṃ zhes brjod/ dbugs nang du zhugs pa'i tshe bcings pa slar grol yid kyis āḥzhes brjod/ rlung gnas pa'i ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + tshe nyi ma'i ¡¶ lu ¡· + zla ba'i ) bu ga nas zhugs te thig le la thim par bsam zhing yid kyis hūm̐ zhes brjod do/ /'di'i rim pas rtag tu bsgoms pas rtags dang yon tan 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sngags kyi bdag nyid kyi rim pa'o// //de'i rjes su nyi zla thig le dang bcas pa snga ma ltar dmigs nas rlung nang du drangs pas yi ge dang bcas pa'i srad bu 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung dang lhan cig thig le la thim ste ¡Ã zla ba'i ( ¡¶ zha ¡· nyi ma'i ) bu ga'ang subs nas nyi zla ga'u 'grigs pa ltar kha sbyar bar bsam zhing steng 'og gi rlung yang kha sbyor du bya'o | | rlung phyir gtong ba'i tshe yi ge dang bcas pa'i srad bu byung zhing phyed dang bdun du dkris par bsam mo/ /'di'i rim pas rtag tu bsgoms nas snga ma bas lhag pa'i rtags dang yon tan 'byung bar 'gyur te/ dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i chos kyi bdag nyid kyi rim pa gnyis pa'o// //de'i rjes su rang nyid he ru ka'i sku stod nyi ma sku smad zla ba nyi zla'ang thig le la thim nas thig le nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar mi dmigs par 'gyur ba'i ngang la yid mnyam par bzhag go /tshul 'di rtag tu bsgoms pa las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur te/ dmigs pa med pa'i chos kyi bdag nyid kyi rim pa gsum pa'o// //rgya cher de kho na nyid kyi man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /nyal ba dang ni ldang ba dang | | mchod gtor zas kyi bya ba dang*/

/bzlas pa dang ni spyod lam ste/ / yan lag drug gis yan lag bsdus/ /de la thog mar nyal ba'i tshe/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab ste/ tshur 'dus pas snod bcud dang 'khor 'das rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad gtso bo yab yum la bsdus nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes su chags pa'i mes gtso bo yab yum yang 'od du zhu nas nam mkha'i dbyings su g.yo ba med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le gcig tu gyur par bsams la mi rtog pa'i ngang la nyal bar bya'o/ /nyal ba'o/ /ldang ba'i tshe sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang gis thig le de las thig le bzhi 'phros pa lha mo bzhir gyur pas kye ho la sogs pa'i glus bskul te slar 'dres nas gtso bo yab yum gyi skur bzhengs te thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyi snang bas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa snod bcud dang bcas par dmigs la hūm̐ gi sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /ldang ba'o/ /de nas snga dro'i thun mnyam gzhag gong du bshad pa ltar bsgoms nas tshogs 'dums shing bar chad thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir mchod pa dang gtor ma bya ba'i rim pa ni chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga/ nang gi mchod pa/ gtor ma gnyis | rdo rje'i dril bu dang bcas pa mngon du byas nas bdag bskyed gtso bo 'ba' zhig tu bsdus la/ rdzas rnams bsangs shing sbyangs te/ yi ge gsum las grub pa'i lha rdzas su byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal la ba byung dri bzang dang bcas pas khye ma med par byug cing*/ der rten gyi dkyil 'khor skad cig gis dmigs la/ lha'i gnas rnams su dri'i thig le me tog re dang bcas pa rnams gdan du mos nas so so'i sngags brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa rnams skad cig gis lha rnams su gsal bar dmigs la/ mtshams bzhir yang tshom bu cung zad re bkod pa rnams

( ¡¶ zha ¡· + bum pa'i steng du ) bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa rnams su blta'o/ / de nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar bdag bskyed dang mtshungs par byas la gtso bo'i rigs bdag rtsa ba'i bla mar mos shing steng gi nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang | khor yug tu byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de nas phyag rgya dang bcas pas gang gi mchod rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin dngos su dbul zhing*/ sems kyis re re'ang nam mkha'i khams gang bas kyang mchod par mos la ngag tu/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka ma hā mā yā maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + ye ) swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul lo/ /de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pād+yaṃ gis zhal bsil/ me tog dang puṣ+paṃ/ bdug spos dang dhū paṃ/ mar me dang dī paṃ/ dri mchog dang gan+dhaṃ/ zhal zas dang nai be d+ye/ sil snyan dang shap+ta/ zhes pa rnams dang spel bas mchod rdzas de dag gis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gtor bas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ yi dam gyi lha rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phul nas/ myang zhing gnas gsum du gtugs pas rang gi lus kyi lha'ang mchod la/ chos skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa thams cad la'ang sbyin no/ /de nas phyag 'tshal ba'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yul gyi yon tan rjes su dran zhing*/

gang gi drin gyis la sogs pa bla ma'i bstod pa dang*/ mche ba gtsigs pa la sogs pa he ru ka dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rja ེ mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug pa/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams la bstod cing*/ gzhan yang ci shes pas bstod par bya'o/ /de nas nyes ltung dag par bya ba'i phyir/ bshags pa gtso bor gyur pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sdom pa gzung ba dang*/ smon lam rgya chen po rnams gdab par bya'o/ /mchod pa'o/ /de nas gtor ma gnyis mngon par 'du byas pa'i thog ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i steng du āḥlas thod pa'i nang du dbus nas rim pa bzhin du/ hūm̐/ oṃ/ trām̐/ hrīḥ āḥlas/ mi/ glang*/ khyi/ rta | glang po che'i sha lnga dang*/ shar lho nas rim pa bzhin/ lam̐/ mam̐/ pam̐/ tām̐ las | dri chen/ dri chu/ byang chub kyi sems/ rak+ta rnams bskyed nas de rnams kyi steng du/ oṃ dkar po mgo thur du blta ba/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams bskyed nas/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos shing me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams bzhu zhing*/ de'i rlangs pas oṃ dang rdo rje la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun zags shing 'od kyi tshul du phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi nye bar bkug pa rdo rje la thim pas zla ba dang*/ oṃ dang bcas pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + thams cad ) thod pa'i nang du lhung zhing 'dres pa las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por dmigs la yi ge gsum yang brjod cing byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas steng gi nam mkhar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis lhag par mos la/

gong gi yi ge gsum dang drug gis gnas rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying ga'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing | oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā mā yā badz+ra/ a ga dha ya a ga dha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ dho sha ya ngho sha ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī hṛ da yaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod nas bstim mo/ /de nas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la bstabs pas lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥpra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + hūm̐ ) phaṭa/ oṃ bud+dhā ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ trāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ka nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ ho hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs pa brjod pas phul nas/ phyi nang yid las byung bas mchod de/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po

| | rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ / rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo | | rin chen rgyal po rab du zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /dngos nyid dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma'i mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo/ /'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis yul phyogs de na gnas pa'i zhing skyong bas gtso byas pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams bkug par bsam zhing*/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas bkug nas pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ sa ma ya staṃ gyis dam tshig la gnas par bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa ma ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya sarba satāñca sarba pā paṃ byā dhi bigh+nān shīn+taṃ ku ru dhā na pu ṇ+ya ā yurbuṣ+tiṃ ku ru sarba ¡Ã ya ku ru ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ba yaṃ rak+ṣa ¡¶ zha ¡· + ka ra ka ra ) ku ru ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + hūm̐ swā hā ) / zhes lan gsum brjod de phul nas phrin las bcol la chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas gnyis ka'i mthar bkra shis dang smon lam brjod la bzod pa gsol nas gshegs su gsol zhing dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rang la bsdus nas gnas gsum bsrung ngo*/ / bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas dam tshig pa rang la bsdus la/

las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /mchod pa dang gtor ma'i rim pa'o | | zas kyi bya ba ni kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas rang he ru kar dmigs pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod du snying gar lha'i dkyil 'khor bla mas dbur brgyan pa la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lte bar chos skyong srung ma dur khrod kyi bdag po phyogs bdag dang zhing skyong la 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba dmigs nas/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kha hom khung lce'i ¡Ã rtsa ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· rtse mor ) rdo rje rtse lnga pa sbu gu dang bcas pa bsams la nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis zos pas rdo rje'i sbu gu nas bdud rtsi'i char babs pas 'khor 'das kyi lha thams cad mnyes shing tshim par bsam mo/ /oṃ āḥ hūm̐ gu h+ye/ bak+ṣ+ya bak+ṣ+ya haṃ zhes pa ni bdud rtsi myang ba'i sngags so/ /lhag ma ni lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin pa ni zas kyi bya ba'o/ /de nas bskyed rim gyi rjes sam gang yang rung bar bzlas pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar sa bon rnams dmigs nas gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ bha ga nas 'thon/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas nas zhugs shing 'khor bas rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ zhes pa ni gtso bo'i sngags so/ /oṃ bud+dha ḍa ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ gtso mo'i'o/ /'khor gyi lha mo rnams la ni rang rang gi thugs kar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon skor du 'khor bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī āḥhrī:hūm̐/ lha mo rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ āḥ hūm̐/

thun mong gi sngags so// 'bum phrag brgyad bzlas pas ni dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba la 'jug par dbang zhing mchog sgrub pa la ni tshad med do/ /bzlas pa'o/ /spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs nas dag pa dran par bya ste/ gzhal yas khang pa ni lam gyi tshogs ( ¡¶ lu ¡· chos ) rnam par dag pa/ dur khrod ni 'khor ba dang lus rnam par dag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni sa dang gzugs dang gti mug dag pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ni chu dang tshor ba dang ser sna dag pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes | pad+ma mkha' 'gro ni me dang 'du shes dang 'dod chags dag pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ni rlung dang 'du byed dang phrag dog dag pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nam mkha' dang rnam par shes pa dang zhe sdang dag pa ni sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ de dag thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni dpal he ru ka'o zhes dag pa dran par byas nas lha mo rnams zhal bzhi la bsdus shing yum yab la bsdus nas/ yab kyi dbang po lnga lha mo lngar dmigs la | rang gi lus dang snang ba thams cad he ru ka brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs nas yul ¡Ã rnams kyis ( ¡¶ zha ¡· lhas ) skye mched kyi lha la mchod par bsam zhing*/ sdang zhen med par longs spyad do/ /spyod lam mo// //de ltar mnyam gzhag dang yan lag gi rnal 'byor gnyis la rtag tu legs par gnas pa ni dngos grub ma lus pa'i mthar son pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang yang ring por mi thogs par 'gyur ro/ /'di yi brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ku ku ri pa mtsho skyes ḍoṃ bi pa/ /ti lo nā ro zhi ba bzang por bcas/ /chos kyi blo gros chos kyi rdo rje dang

| | zhe sdang rdo rje la sogs yab sras dang*/ /dbang phyug grags dang mkhyen rab dpal las brgyud/ /ku ku ri pa 'dul ba sbyin dang shān+ti pa/ /dam tshig rdo rje sogs kyis sbyar ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ /'brel pa'i tshogs kyang mthong zhing thos la man ngag gis/ /nges par byas pas chos tshul 'di la bdag blo dge | de ming blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /de la ye shes 'byung gnas dpal// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang bcas pas/ /gsol ba btab nas 'di sbyar ro// byed pa sgyu ma las byung ba'i/ /dge ba sgyu ma gang bsags pas/ /'khor ba'i sgyu ma ma lus pa/ /ye shes sgyu mar rol gyur cig /dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ dge slong sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes bya bas shing mo glang gi lo ston zla ra ba la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /yang sgrub thabs bsdus pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma hā mā yā bsgom par 'dod pas stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du ma hā mā yā bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom | de nas rang gi snying gi nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥsngon po bsgom | de las 'od 'phros pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad dag de'i rkyen gyis rang he ru kar gyur/ de'ang pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + phyag bzhi ) pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas ser | rgyab dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + mche ba gtsigs pa ) / phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+waṃ ga nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar bsnams shing*/

'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can | rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can | dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams nas/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar dmigs la yid mi 'phro'i ngang du sems mnyam par bzhag go /de nas bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥsngon po bsgoms nas/ de'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba 'khor ¡Ã bas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ba'i 'od kyis ) sdig pa dang sgrib pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + thams cad ) dag cing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'jug par bsgoms la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ zhes ci nus pa bzla'o/ /gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/ gtor ma bshams shing sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas he ru ka la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la | oṃ shrī he ru ka pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ de nas badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod/ ¡Ã mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas ¡¶ lu ¡· - mche ba 'tshal lo/ /zhes ) bstod la/ bdag la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsol ba btab/ de nas badz+ra muḥ sa mgron gshegs su gsol/ zas za ba'i tshe kha zas/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang he ru kar dmigs pa'i snying gar bla ma dkon mchog dang*/ lto bar 'jig rten pa'i tshogs rnams dmigs nas de rnams mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyad do/ /spyod lam thams cad he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o/ /nub mor nyal ba'i tshe chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang du nyal lo/ /nangs par ldang ba'i tshe lha'i nga rgyal gyis ldang ngo*/ /dus thams cad du dam tshig dang sdom pa bskyang ba la nan tan du bya'o/ /snang ba lha yi dkyil 'khor te/ /rlung gi 'gro 'ong bzlas pa'i mchog /sems kyi cho 'phrul ting nge 'dzin/ /'di shes pa la don min med | | ma hā mā yā'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa'i man ngag gi rjes su 'brangs nas sngags 'chang ba 'phags pas ¡Ã bya'i lo zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes gsum la bris pa'o/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /ku ku ri pa mtsho skyes dang*/ /ḍoṃ bi pa dang ti lo pa/ /nā ro zhi ba bzang por bcas/ /mar pa gzhung pa yab sras dang*/ /glog skya mkhyen rab dam pa'i dpal/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pa rnams/ /chos 'di'i brgyud pa'i rim pa yin/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· me mo byi ba'i dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes gsum la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o / / sa ma pa thā mi thi/ rdo rje 'chang dang mkha' 'gro ma/ /ku ku ri pa te lo pa/ /nā ro zhi ba bzang por bcas/ /mar pa gzhung pa yab sras dang*/ /glog skya mkhyen rab dam pa'i dpal/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pa'o/ /thung brgyud yin no// //maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu/ ) // //༄༅/ /sgyu ma chen mo'i tshogs 'khor bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ sgyu ma chen mo la phyag 'tshalalo/ /dpal mchog bde chen sgyu ma'i sku/ /mi zad gsang ba gsum bdag nyid/ /sgyu ma chen mor phyag 'tshal nas/ /de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga bshad/

/'dir sngags dang sman gyis kun tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i dug yongs su bsten pa ni/ zas dang sman gzhan pas bcud dang phan yon che ba ltar/ gang gis yongs su gdung bar 'gyur ba 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa de dang de dag thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis byin gyis brlabs nas yongs su spyad na/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang nyon mongs pa la mi mthun pa'i phyogs su lta ba'i lam de dag pas khyad par du 'phags pa nyid do/ /de nyid kyi phyir nyan thos kyi sde snod las/ 'dod pa dang 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams dug dang*/ mtshon dang*/ chom rkun dang*/ rab tu 'bar ba'i me dang 'dra bar bstan pas shin tu smad par gyur pa de nyid byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dag las/ thabs kyis yongs su zin na lam la phan par 'gyur bar bstan te/ ji skad du rgyal ba'i yum las/ byang chub sems dpa' la la la ni pha dang ma dang chung ma dang bu dang bu mo dag kyang gdon mi za bar dgos so/ /zhes pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la la la ni thabs mkhas pas sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la yongs su spyad de/ chung ma'i 'khor gyi nang nas mngon par byung nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes bya ba dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ 'od srungs grong khyer gyi ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + mi gtsang ba'i ) lud gang yin pa de ni/ 'bras kyi zhing dang*/ bu ram gyi zhing dang*/ til gyi zhing la phan pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs pa'i lud gang yin pa de yang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la phan pa yin no/ / zhes gsungs la 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ byis pa rnams ni gzugs la chags/ /bar pa rnams ni chags bral 'gyur/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis gzugs kyi ni/ /rang bzhin shes nas rnam par grol/

/zhes gsungs so | | rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las lam gyi dngos gzhir gsungs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ chags can ye shes 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu 'dod yon lnga rnams bsten/ /zhes pa dang*/ kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud las kyang*/ / skye bo mi bzad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /chags pas 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur ba/ /'dod chags nyid kyis rnam par grol/ /bzlog pa'i bsgom pa 'di nyidani/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs cis mi shes/ /zhes 'byung ngo | | de'i phyir phyi dang nang gi bde ba chen po thabs khyad par du 'phags pa dang bcas pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa ni/ nges par rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'phral du mngon du byed pa'i phyir tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rmad du byung ba'i thabs kyis/ phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor mchod pa dang | ye shes bsgrub pa la brtson par bya'o/ /de'ang las dang po pa rnams la ¡Ã nye bar gdams ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· phan gdag ) pa'i phyir de dag gi ji ltar bya ba'i tshul brjod par bya'o/ /de'ang dus khyad par can la bab ba'i tshe dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas byi dor legs par byas te/ bla re la sogs pas legs par brgyan nas 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i dkon mchog gi rten nye bar bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i thod par chang dang bdud rtsi sbyar bas bkang ba'i nang gi mchod pa dang*/ shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma gsum dang

| rdo rje dril bu dang med du mi rung ba'i rdzas kha na ma tho ba dang bral ba'i sha dang*/ chang dang*/ gzhan yang bza' ba dang*/ btung ba gya nom pa rnams legs par 'tshogs par bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi gtso bo gral gyi thog mar 'khod nas/ dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams rgan rim gyis gnas pa la/ las kyi slob mas maṇ+ḍal dang so so la me tog phul nas phyag 'tshal te/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang*/ /yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis bsag pa'i phyir/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ me tog rnams bsdus te tshogs kyi gtso bo la dbul/ des kyang bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la dbul te/ cho ga la 'jug par rjes su gnang ba'i don du gsol ba btab nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis gnas khang de mi dmigs te stong par bsams pa'i ngang las/ rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin dang 'dra ba'i mchod rdzas thams cad kyis yongs su gang bar bsam zhing*/ nang gi mchod pa la'ang āḥlas thod pa chen po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsams la/ thams cad kyang oṃ ā:hūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas sdig pa dang sgrib pa 'dag par bya ba'i don du rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas yi ge brgya pa ci rigs pa bzlas nas/ sgyu ma chen mo'i mngon par rtogs pa gsal bar bsgoms la/ bzlas pa ci nus pa byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta'i sngags brjod cing nang mchod kyis mchod rdzas rnams bsangs nas | swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las mchod pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i | oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge zhu ba las ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba'i mchod rdzas su bskyed nas/

so so'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun na dmigs pa'i rten yod pa'am med kyang rung ste/ skad cig gis rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gsal bar dmigs nas/ dbu rgyan la rigs bdag gi rgyas btab pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bsgoms la | rigs kyi bdag po nyid bla ma dang gnyis su med par bsams pa'i mtha' mar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor bar blta'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin bzung nas mchod par bsam zhing sgrub pa'i thabs nas 'byung ba'i sngags ting nge 'dzin phyag rgya rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gtor ba'i thor ma rnams thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med par gyur pas so so la mchod par bsam zhing*/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ yi dam gyi lha gzhan dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la so so'i sngags dang mtshan gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas phul nas rang gi lce dang*/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su bdud rtsis reg pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsams nas chos skyong ba dang*/ srung ma gzhan dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ dur khrod kyi bdag po dang*/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ gza' dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad la so so'i sngags dang*/ mtshan gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing phul la/ mthar gzhi bdag dang 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la byin pas mnyes shing tshim par bsam mo/

/de nas bdag dang mchod pa'i lha mo de dag nyid kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /la sogs pas bla ma dang | mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bstod nas nyes ltung gi tshogs dag cing dam tshig dang sdom pa brtan par byung ba'i phyir rgyun bshags dang*/ sdom pa gzung ba yang lan gsum gyi bar du bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma nang gi mchod pa dang*/ chu dang*/ chang gis sbyangs la/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong ba dang*/ gsum pa yul de'i zhing skyong ba rnams la so so'i cho gas dbul bar bya'o/ /mdun bskyed mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas bdag bskyed mchod pa'i phyir tshogs kyi yo byad rnams lhan cig bsogs la nang mchod kyis gtor nas bsang ba dang*/ sbyang ba dang byin gyis brlab pa rnams gtor ma rgyas pa ltar byas te*/ slar yang nang mchod nas thams cad la gtor bas yo byad thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du ro gcig bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa dang*/ ha ho hrīḥzhes yang yang brjod nas byin gyis brlab bo/ /des mdun bskyed dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi thugs dam bskang bar bsam zhing*/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ bdag gis bshams pa'i tshogs kyi yo byad 'di/ /zag pa med pa'i yon tan kun ldan zhing*/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rab 'phro ba/ /nam mkha' yongs su khyab par mngon sprul te/ /bla ma rnams dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs rnams la/ /rab tu gus pa'i yid kyis bdag dbul zhing*/ /sdig dang ltung ba thams cad bshags pa dang | | nongs pa thams cad bzod par gsol bgyid kyis/ /ci bder bzhes nas bdag ¡Ã yid dag pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· nyid dga' ba ) dang*/

/smon pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas a ho su khaṃ zhes brjod cing ma da na dang ba la'i phud mchod pa dang gtor ma la phul nas las kyi slob mas/ tshogs kyi gtso bo la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ gzhan rnams la mi 'tshal bar/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'du ba rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang*/ /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du bzhes | | zhes brjod cing drang*/ des kyang*/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med | | 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba | | de bzhin nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing blang*/ gnyis kas rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ a ho su khaṃ zhes brjod do/ / bza' btung gzhan thams cad kyang sngags de nyid kyis drang zhing blangs nas/ dam tshig gi phud nang mchod kyi skabs ltar dang*/ zas kyi phud phul nas kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas longs spyad do/ /las kyi slob mas ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + gzhan ) dam tshig ma thob kyi bar du gzhan rnams kyis dam tshig gi rdzas sa la mi gzhag cing*/ tshogs kyi gtso bos longs ma spyod par gzhan gyis longs m-i spyad la/ snod kha sbub dang*/ stong par mi bzhag go /der 'dus pa'i gang zag rnams he ru ka'i ngo bo yin pas bzang ngan gyi rtog pa mi bya ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i yo byad thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir/ gtsangami gtsang dang rung mi rung mi dbye'o/ /rab tu myos pa'i chang mi btung zhing chags sdang gi rnam rtog dang*/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i gtam mi bya'o/ / rang nyid grogs dang bcas pa la de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'du shes dang*/ kha zas la ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i 'du shes dang*/ longs spyod pa la lha mchod pa'i 'du shes yang yang gsal gdab cing mchod par bya ba dang | mchod par byed pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yul thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya'o/

/yo byad rnams la brda'i ming gis smos par bya ste/ chang la ma da na dang*/ sha la ba la dang*/ kha zas gzhan la tri pi ta dang*/ thugs pa la ma la tin dha naṃ/ snod la pad+ma bhañja na/ zhes brjod kyi phal pa'i skad kyis mi brjod do/ /yid spro na phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod pa dang | ting nge 'dzin brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ glu dang gar gyi mchod pa yang bya ste | skyes pas glu len na 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ bud med kyis glu len na gos dkar mo dang*/ skyes pas gar byed pa rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ bud med kyis gar byed na sangs rgyas spyan gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa dang*/ glu ngag dag par byed pa sngags dang*/ gar lus dag par byed pa phyag rgya dang*/ stang stabs thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par rol pas 'phags pa mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don 'byung bar bsam zhing*/ glu dang gar bya'o | | bag med pas rnam par g.yengs pa'i rgod pa dang*/ gnyid dang rmugs pa la sogs pa bying bar mi bya zhing*/ cho ga ma tshar gyi bar du tshogs kyi khang pa'i phyi rol du 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /gal te 'gro dgos na bla ma'am grogs la zhus nas/ rnal 'byor ma nyams par song la slar ldog par bya'o/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i kha zas dbang ma thob pa la mi sbyin zhing*/ gal te ster dgos na lhag ma'i gtor ma'i sngags kyis lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la bsngos nas byin na nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /bza' ba dang btung bas tshim pa dang snying gar ma da na'i thig le byas la/ rang he ru ka yab yum du gsal bar dmigs nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bde ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dga' ) ba chen pos phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ snang ba thams cad kyang bde ba chen po'i rkyen drug tu 'char bar bltas nas/ bde ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bza' btung gi lhag ma rnams bsdus pa la tshogs kyi gtso bos 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab ste/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i tshogs la byin par bsam zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro'i sngags ( ¡¶ zha ¡· sngags ) lan bdun ( ¡¶ lu ¡· gsum ) brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bha k+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes lnga'am bdun gyis bsngos la tshim par bsams nas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams mnyes shing dngos grub blang ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa thams cad byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas | kol+la e re a bo lā mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ gha ṇe kri pi ṭa ho khādz+dzā i/ kā ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dzā ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + a ) i/ gā ḍeṃ ma a nā pidz+dza ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + a ) i/ ha le kā liñja ra pa ṇi a i/ dun+du ra bādz+dzi a i | tsa u sa ma kats+tshu ri sih+la/ kap+pu ra lā i a ī/ mā la in+dhaṇa sā liñja ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a ī/ phreṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te shung+ngha a shud+dha na ma ṇi a ī/ ni rāṃ shu aṃ ge tsā ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun+du ru bāṭ+ṭā i/ ḍiṇ+ḍi ma ta hin+na badz+dzi a i/ zhes rdo rje'i glu blang ngo*/ /de nas phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /zhes pa la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgyas par brjod pa'i mthar/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs | | nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa | | dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las/ phyogs dang dus kun tu rgyal bar gyur cig ces bkra shis kyi tshig gis bkra shis par bya'o/ / de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la dngos grub slong ba'i bsam pas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas/ /bden ba des ni lha mo de dag rnams
